QuestInfo.name: Checking on Kerning City
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. \r\nMeet Dark Lord in Kerning City to see how things are going there.
QuestInfo.2: Dark Lord says that Kerning City has recently acquired reinforcements and is prepared for the Black Mage.

0.0: We can't rest easy yet,  #h0#. There is more work to be done.
0.1: The Black Mage's resurrection is imminent. The Explorers of the Maple Alliance need to be ready.
0.2: So I want you to check with #bDark Lord#k in Kerning City and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.

yes.0: Every town must be prepared, but we have so little time...

1.1: It was Athena Pierce... Tell her that Kerning City is ready. I have my Thieves in position, day and night.

yes.0: If you consider yourself a true Thief, train to heighten your senses to be ready for the dangers ahead.

npc.0: I want you to check with #bDark Lord#k in Kerning City and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.
